full_name: Annalisa Quaini | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Mathematics William and Flora Hewlett Foundation Fellow University of Houston
bio: Annalisa Quaini is an associate professor of mathematics at the University of Houston. She is interested in the development and implementation of computational methods for partial differential equations (PDE), with a particular focus on computational fluid dynamics. Her research thus far has been related primarily to PDE problems arising in biomedicine and biomedical engineering applications.
